paper.title_en: The quadratic growth of Krylov spread complexity in the BTZ black hole
paper.abstract_en: The boundary quantity that captures the growth of black-hole interiors quantified by holographic complexity remains unknown beyond 2d dilaton gravity. We provide a critical analysis of a partition-function construction of Krylov spread complexity for thermofield-double states that provides a dimension-independent boundary reconstruction from semiclassical holographic partition functions, while developing the present dynamical and bulk construction for the BTZ saddle. In the double-scaled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, where exact and semiclassical results can be compared, we show that the classical limit is reliable only when taken after the complexity has been reconstructed; taking this limit at the level of individual Lanczos coefficients discards essential information. Applying the construction to a large-central-charge two-dimensional conformal field theory above the Hawking-Page temperature dual to a Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole, we find an intermediate departure from early-time quadratic growth followed by behavior compatible with a return toward asymptotically quadratic growth, rather than the linear late-time behavior of the volume and the standard finite-functional complexity = anything class. We then match this boundary behavior to a generalized complexity = anything bulk object built from an infinite series of extrinsic-curvature invariants. The construction provides a systematic route from black-hole thermodynamics to Krylov dynamics and can naturally be extended to higher-dimensional holographic black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文深入探讨了BTZ黑洞中Krylov展开复杂度的二次增长，将全息复杂度与黑洞热力学联系起来，具有高度的理论深度和新颖性，符合本索引的主题。
decision.title_zh: BTZ黑洞中Krylov展开复杂度的二次增长
decision.abstract_zh: 捕获由全息复杂度量化的黑洞内部增长的边界量在二维膨胀引力之外仍然未知。我们提供了一个对热场双态Krylov展开复杂度的配分函数构造的批判性分析，该构造从半经典全息配分函数提供了维度无关的边界重建，同时为BTZ鞍点发展了当前的动力学和体构造。在双标度Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型中，精确和半经典结果可以进行比较，我们表明经典极限只有在复杂度被重建之后才可靠；在单个Lanczos系数层面取此极限会丢弃基本信息。将该构造应用于大中心荷二维共形场论，在Hawking-Page温度之上对偶于Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli黑洞，我们发现了早期二次增长的中期偏离，随后出现与渐进二次增长回归相容的行为，而不是体积和标准有限泛函复杂度=任何东西类的线性晚期行为。然后，我们将该边界行为匹配到由无限序列外曲率不变量构建的广义复杂度=任何东西体对象。该构造提供了从黑洞热力学到Krylov动力学的系统性途径，并且可以自然地扩展到高维全息黑洞。
